html:
SMTO-MEM-0027 — SMTO got a request for an unknown kind of Knowledge settings

GUID: 8f58134f-2ff4-5ea3-adf1-96e4973bca96
Slug: knowledge-invalid-lane
Domain: MEM · Subsystem: knowledge

What happened

  • SMTO was asked to change Knowledge settings for a category it doesn't have; only document and Memory settings exist. The settings weren't changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Copy any text you haven't saved yet, then reload the page. Reloading makes sure the page and the server start the change from the same current settings.
  2. Open Knowledge, go to Document settings or Semantic memory, and make the change once more. Those are the only two kinds of Knowledge settings, so starting from them sends a supported request.
  3. If it fails again, select Copy error details. This error comes from inside SMTO, and the details show which part of SMTO sent the unknown category.

What success looks like

  • The settings save and show your new values.

If it still fails

  • Send the copied error details to the person who manages SMTO; parts of SMTO may be on different versions. Don't keep re-saving the same change; it will be rejected the same way.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • RagStore.configure (embedding_application.configure) rejected a settings change because the lane is neither 'documents' nor 'memory'; the HTTP settings route already restricts the lane, so the caller is internal or programmatic.

What this means

  • This request names a retrieval category the server does not support. The original operation and completed work retain their own recorded outcomes; this diagnostic does not replay them.

Why this can happen

  • The component reported invalid_lane. This does not establish the outcome of unrelated operations.

How to diagnose it

  • The updated page requests a supported retrieval category.
  • Inspect the error reference and the affected component’s current observation before selecting a recovery action.

How to fix it

  • Find the caller passing the unsupported lane in the Server log traceback (an embedding activation step, a script or other direct Python caller) and correct it to documents or memory. If installed SMTO components are on different versions (for example the Server and the inference controller), update them so they match, then restart the Server.
  • Reload the page after keeping unsaved text. If this repeats, copy the error details for the administrator to check page/server compatibility.

Retry and execution caution

  • The updated page requests a supported retrieval category.

How to verify the fix

  • The updated page requests a supported retrieval category.

What not to do

  • Do not delete retained task data or repeat an operation with an unknown outcome.

Technical notes

  • Status checks do not replay tasks or modify source documents.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
